company.name: InterSwap
company.shortDescription: InterSwap Labs offers cross-chain native asset swaps and unified liquidity on the Axelar network.
company.description: InterSwap Labs enables secure and seamless swaps of native assets across multiple blockchain networks with a single transaction, eliminating the need for intermediary chains or bridges. It offers bridgeless liquidity unification and transportation across EVM, Cosmos, Solana, and Bitcoin. Built on the Axelar network, InterSwap Labs is the first fully composable native asset cross-chain Automated Market Maker (AMM) with unified liquidity.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $2,400,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $15,059,864 to $15,059,864, a 1x increase.
